parties: Matel Motion & Energy Solutions Private Limited (fundraiser); UC Impower (lead investor); Catamaran Ventures (new investor); Transition VC (existing investor)
headline: Khaitan & Co, JSA act on Matel ₹130 crore Series B fundraise
sum: Pune-based energy-efficient motor manufacturer Matel raised ₹130 crore in Series B from a consortium led by UC Impower, with new investor Catamaran and existing backer Transition VC. The capital will fund manufacturing expansion, R&D acceleration, product development and hiring in engineering and production.
implication: Mid-stage cleantech infrastructure fundraises in India increasingly attract marquee institutional capital (Infosys founder-backed Catamaran, UC Impower climate fund), signalling investor focus on supply-chain localisation for EV powertrains; counsel should track state-specific manufacturing incentives and FAME II compliance pathways.
detail: <cite index="1-1,2-1">Matel Motion & Energy Solutions, a Pune-based motor manufacturer, raised ₹130 crore in Series B led by UC Impower</cite>. <cite index="2-4">Catamaran joined as new investor while existing investor Transition VC also participated</cite>. <cite index="2-6">The capital will expand manufacturing capacity, strengthen R&D, accelerate product development, and support international expansion</cite>. <cite index="1-2,1-3">Founded in 2017, the company designs and manufactures integrated powertrains for automotive and industrial applications, and is among the first in India to offer PMSM-based IE5 ultra-high-efficiency industrial motors, with IE6 under development</cite>.
